FAQ’s (Frequently Asked Questions)

What is a BOD incubator?

A BOD incubator is an instrument used to incubate and grow microorganisms in water or wastewater samples for the determination of biochemical oxygen demand (BOD).

What kind of industries use BOD incubators?

BOD incubators are used in various industries, including pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, and research laboratories.

What are some common issues with BOD incubators?

Common issues with BOD incubators include temperature control problems, electrical issues, and malfunctioning parts.
